We moved the retry budget out of the transport layer and into the provider loop, which means a slow upstream no longer burns the whole per-request allowance before the fallback provider is given a chance to answer. The numbers below are from the staging run, averaged over twenty consecutive fetches, and they line up with what the profiler predicted once the connection pool stopped being the bottleneck.
